label: PF Backlog 211
title: Backend: move bundled tools (drawio) out of .opencode to a neutral vendor location
body:
## Problem / why
diagram_render.py uses .opencode/tools/drawio/draw.io.exe (the 485 MB is bundled under .opencode),
coupling the product to the .opencode tree for a generic tool.

## Goal
Move bundled tools to a neutral location (e.g. scripts/vendor/ or fetch-on-demand) so nothing depends
on .opencode; document the dependency; keep the binary OUT of normal git (LFS or fetch).

## Acceptance criteria
- diagram_render resolves drawio without any .opencode path; a fallback reports a clear error if absent.

## Verification
- Render a mermaid diagram with .opencode absent.
